verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents an official first-party Solid routing library. The GitHub material covers state, SSR, Context, Portals, Suspense and Vite integration, but never routing. The only routing mention is a community complaint about SolidStart routing being slow, which does not establish that SolidStart is a first-party router library or show how well it integrates with Solid.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use an official first-party routing library that integrates seamlessly with the framework
